<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="app-version" content="10.4.6">
<meta name="app-date" content="1405/04/06">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/manifest+json;base64,eyJuYW1lIjogIkxhZWdoIEVsZWN0cm9uaWMgUGFyc2lhbiIsICJzaG9ydF9uYW1lIjogIkxhZWdoIEVQUyIsICJzdGFydF91cmwiOiAiLiIsICJzY29wZSI6ICIuIiwgImRpc3BsYXkiOiAic3RhbmRhbG9uZSIsICJiYWNrZ3JvdW5kX2NvbG9yIjogIiNmZmZmZmYiLCAidGhlbWVfY29sb3IiOiAiIzFlM2E1ZiIsICJsYW5nIjogImZhIiwgImRpciI6ICJydGwifQ==">
<title>Laegh Electronic Parsian — سیستم خدمات پس از فروش</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Vazirmatn:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap');
:root{
  --blue:#185FA5;--blue2:#0C447C;--blue-l:#E6F1FB;
  --green:#2E7D32;--green-l:#E8F5E9;
  --amber:#E65100;--amber-l:#FFF3E0;
  --red:#C62828;--red-l:#FFEBEE;
  --purple:#6A1B9A;--purple-l:#F3E5F5;
  --border:#E0E0E0;--bg:#F5F5F5;--card:#FFFFFF;
  --text:#212121;--text2:#757575;
  --sidebar:220px;
  --font:'Tahoma',sans-serif;
}
body.fv{--font:'Vazirmatn',sans-serif;}
body.fc{--font:'Calibri','Tahoma',sans-serif;}
body.ffa{--font:'Arial',sans-serif;}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
body{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-size:13px;}
/* SIDEBAR */
.sb{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;width:var(--sidebar);height:100vh;background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;z-index:100;overflow-y:auto;}
.sb-logo{padding:14px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);text-align:center;cursor:pointer;}
.sb-logo img{max-width:130px;max-height:48px;object-fit:contain;}
.sb-brand{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);margin-top:5px;line-height:1.5;}
.sb-nav{flex:1;padding:6px 0;}
.sb-section{font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);padding:10px 14px 4px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.nav-it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);transition:.15s;border-right:3px solid transparent;}
.nav-it:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;}
.nav-it.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff;border-right-color:#fff;}
.nav-it svg{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0;}
.sb-foot{padding:10px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:10px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-align:center;}
/* MAIN */
.main{margin-right:var(--sidebar);min-height:100vh;}
.topbar{background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;}
.topbar-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);}
.page{display:none;padding:20px;}
.page.active{display:block;}
/* CARDS */
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04);}
.card-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px;}
/* GRID */
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.g5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
/* FORM */
.f{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;}
.f label{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:500;}
.f input,.f select,.f textarea{font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;background:#FAFAFA;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font);direction:rtl;width:100%;transition:.15s;}
.f input:focus,.f select:focus,.f textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--blue);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(24,95,165,.08);}
.f textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:80px;line-height:1.6;}
/* AUTOCOMPLETE */
.acw{position:relative;}
.acl{position:absolute;z-index:999;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:7px;max-height:140px;overflow-y:auto;width:100%;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.1);}
.acl div{padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:var(--text);}
.acl div:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
/* BUTTONS */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);background:var(--card);color:var(--text);transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.btn:hover{background:var(--bg);border-color:#bbb;}
.btn-p{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
.btn-p:hover{background:var(--blue2);}
.btn-g{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff;}
.btn-g:hover{background:#1B5E20;}
.btn-r{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red);}
.btn-r:hover{background:var(--red-l);}
.btn-o{background:var(--amber);border-color:var(--amber);color:#fff;}
.btn-o:hover{background:#BF360C;}
.btn-pu{background:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple);color:#fff;}
.btn-sm{padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;}
.btn-bar{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;}
/* BADGE */
.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;}
.badge-open{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber);}
.badge-closed{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green);}
.badge-inv{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2);border:1px solid #85B7EB;padding:5px 12px;font-size:13px;}
/* SIDEBAR COUNT BADGE */
.nav-it{position:relative;}
.nav-badge{margin-right:auto;background:#fff;color:var(--blue2);border-radius:9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;min-width:16px;text-align:center;}
.nav-badge.urgent{background:var(--red);color:#fff;}
.sb-section{cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;user-select:none;}
.sb-section .chev{transition:.15s;font-size:9px;}
.sb-section.collapsed .chev{transform:rotate(-90deg);}
.sb-group.collapsed .nav-it{display:none;}
/* DATE PICKER */
.dp-pop{position:fixed;z-index:500;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:12px;width:280px;font-size:12px;}
.dp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:8px;}
.dp-head button{background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--blue2);padding:2px 8px;}
.dp-title{font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);}
.dp-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:3px;text-align:center;}
.dp-grid .dow{color:#999;font-size:10px;padding:3px 0;}
.dp-grid .day{padding:5px 0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;}
.dp-grid .day:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
.dp-grid .day.today{border:1px solid var(--blue);}
.dp-grid .day.sel{background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;}
.dp-grid .day.empty{visibility:hidden;}
.dp-foot{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;}
.dp-time{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;}
.dp-time input{width:38px;text-align:center;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:5px;}
/* TASK MODULE */
.task-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.task-tab{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;background:#eef2f7;color:#789;}
.task-tab.active{background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;}
.task-row{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:8px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.task-row.overdue{border-color:var(--red);background:#FFF5F5;}
.task-row.done{opacity:.5;}
.task-pr{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:8px;}
.task-pr-urgent{background:#FFE0E0;color:var(--red);}
.task-pr-high{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber);}
.task-pr-normal{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2);}
.task-pr-low{background:#eee;color:#888;}
.task-grp-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#789;margin:14px 0 6px;}
/* DEVICE CARD */
.dev-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:10px;background:#FAFCFF;}
.dev-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px;}
.dev-num{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.dev-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue2);}
.cost-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed #ddd;}
.cost-lbl{font-size:11px;text-align:center;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px;margin-top:3px;}
.lbl-est{background:var(--amber-l);color:var(--amber);}
.lbl-disc{background:var(--purple-l);color:var(--purple);}
.lbl-fin{background:var(--green-l);color:var(--green);}
/* TOTAL BAR */
.total-bar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:18px;padding:10px 0 4px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ti{text-align:center;}
.ti-lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);}
.ti-val{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;}
/* SAVED TABLE */
.stbl{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;}
.stbl th{text-align:right;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);font-weight:700;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;background:#FAFAFA;}
.stbl td{padding:7px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #F5F5F5;vertical-align:middle;}
.stbl tr:hover td{background:#F8FBFF;}
.stbl input[type=checkbox]{width:14px;height:14px;cursor:pointer;}
/* PRODUCT */
.prod-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;background:var(--card);transition:.15s;cursor:pointer;}
.prod-card:hover{border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-l);}
.prod-img{width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#f9f9f9;}
.prod-code{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.prod-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue2);margin:2px 0;}
.prod-brand{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);}
/* PHONEBOOK */
.pb-card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.pb-card:hover{background:var(--blue-l);border-color:var(--blue);}
.pb-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue2);}
.ph-tag{background:var(--blue-l);color:var(--blue2);padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;}
/* MODAL */
.ov{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:999;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.ov.open{display:flex;}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:22px;width:92%;max-width:560px;max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;position:relative;}
.modal-lg{max-width:760px;}
.modal-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;color:var(--blue2);}
.modal-x{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:#999;line-height:1;}
/* SEARCH BAR */
.search-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;align-items:center;}
.search-in{flex:1;min-width:160px;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;font-size:12px;font-family:var(--font);}
/* NOTIF */
.notif-c{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center;pointer-events:none;}
.notif{background:#222;color:#fff;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;pointer-events:auto;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.2);}
.notif.show{opacity:1;}
.notif.err{background:var(--red);}
.notif.ok{background:var(--green);}
/* POSTAL PRINT */
.fab{position:fixed;bottom:22px;left:22px;z-index:500;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:50px;padding:11px 20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(24,95,165,.4);font-family:var(--font);display:none;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.fab:hover{background:var(--blue2);}
@media print{
  .sb,.topbar,.btn-bar,.modal,.notif-c,button,.no-print{display:none!important;}
  .main{margin-right:0!important;}
  @page{size:A4;margin:8mm;}
  body{font-size:10px;}
}
.postal-wrap{display:flex;gap:10px;font-family:var(--font);direction:rtl;}
.postal-box{flex:1;border:2px solid #333;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;}
.postal-logo-box{border:1px solid #aaa;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 8px;text-align:center;float:left;margin-right:10px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.postal-logo-box img{max-width:90px;max-height:36px;object-fit:contain;}
.postal-fragile{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;border:3px solid #333;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;}
/* INVENTORY */
.inv-stat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.stat-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;text-align:center;}
.stat-val{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue);}
.stat-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px;}
/* PHONEBOOK CATEGORY TABS */
.pb-cat-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
.pb-cat-tab{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;white-space:nowrap;}
.pb-cat-tab:hover{background:var(--card);}
.pb-cat-tab.active{background:var(--cat-color,var(--blue));color:#fff;border-color:var(--cat-color,var(--blue));font-weight:700;}
/* IMPORT/EXPORT */
.import-zone{border:2px dashed var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--text2);font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.import-zone:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue);}
/* DEBUG PANEL */
.dbg-log{background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;direction:ltr;line-height:1.7;}
.dbg-entry{padding:5px 8px;border-radius:4px;margin-bottom:4px;border-right:3px solid transparent;}
.dbg-entry.err{background:#2d1b1b;border-color:#f85149;color:#ffa198;}
.dbg-entry.warn{background:#2b2200;border-color:#d29922;color:#e3b341;}
.dbg-entry.info{background:#0d2137;border-color:#388bfd;color:#79c0ff;}
.dbg-entry.ok{background:#0d2b1a;border-color:#3fb950;color:#56d364;}
.dbg-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px;opacity:.7;}
.dbg-msg{font-size:12px;direction:rtl;color:#fff;margin-top:2px;}
.dbg-solution{font-size:11px;color:#7ee787;margin-top:4px;padding-top:4px;border-top:1px solid #30363d;}
.dbg-stat-bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.dbg-stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;text-align:center;}
.dbg-stat .val{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;}
.dbg-stat .lbl{font-size:10px;color:var(--text2);margin-top:2px;}
.dbg-health{height:8px;border-radius:4px;background:#30363d;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:14px;}
.dbg-health-bar{height:100%;border-radius:4px;transition:.4s;}
/* AI CHAT */
.ai-chat-box{background:var(--bg2);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;min-height:260px;max-height:400px;overflow-y:auto;margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.ai-msg{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;max-width:85%;line-height:1.6;}
.ai-msg.user{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;align-self:flex-end;border-bottom-right-radius:2px;}
.ai-msg.bot{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);align-self:flex-start;border-bottom-left-radius:2px;}
.ai-msg.typing{opacity:.6;font-style:italic;}
.ai-model-bar{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;}
.ai-model-btn{padding:5px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;}
.ai-model-btn.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue);}
.ai-input-row{display:flex;gap:6px;}
.ai-input-row input{flex:1;}
/* SETTINGS TABS */
.stg-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);margin-bottom:18px;overflow-x:auto;}
.stg-tab{padding:10px 18px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text2);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-2px;white-space:nowrap;transition:.15s;}
.stg-tab:hover{color:var(--text);}
.stg-tab.active{color:var(--blue);border-bottom-color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;}
.stg-panel{display:none;}
.stg-panel.active{display:block;}
/* PRINT SETTINGS */
.print-section-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px;}
.print-section-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.print-preview-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;padding:14px;min-height:120px;color:#333;font-size:11px;direction:rtl;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.print-preview-box.has-bg{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0f4ff 0%,#e8f0fe 100%);}
.print-bg-select{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px;}
.print-bg-opt{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:.15s;}
.print-bg-opt.selected{border-color:var(--blue);}
.color-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;}
.color-dot{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;transition:.15s;}
.color-dot.selected{border-color:var(--text);transform:scale(1.15);}

/* گزارش داخلی شرکت — امضاهای گارانتی */
.company-report{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0f4ff 0%,#e8f0fe 100%);border:2px solid #2563eb33;border-radius:12px;padding:18px;margin-top:4px;animation:crSlideIn .3s ease;}
@keyframes crSlideIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.cr-report-badge{background:#2563eb;color:#fff;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;}
.cr-sign-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:12px;}
.cr-sign-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;}
.cr-sign-box-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#555;margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.cr-sign-line{border-top:1px dashed #bbb;margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.cr-sign-label{font-size:10px;color:#999;text-align:center;}
@media (max-width:700px){.cr-sign-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}

/* ══════ توسعه ظاهر برنامه: تم‌های رنگی، تراکم چیدمان، گردی گوشه، پس‌زمینه ══════ */

/* جلا و افکت‌های نرم روی کارت‌ها و دکمه‌ها */
.card{transition:box-shadow .2s ease;}
.card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08);}
.btn{transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease;}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);}
.btn-p:hover,.btn-g:hover,.btn-o:hover,.btn-pu:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}

/* سواچ تم رنگی */
.theme-swatch{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;border:3px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.15);transition:.15s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:14px;}
.theme-swatch:hover{transform:scale(1.08);}
.theme-swatch.selected{border-color:var(--text);transform:scale(1.12);}

/* حالت تاریک */
body.theme-dark{--bg:#15191e;--card:#1e242c;--text:#e6e9ee;--text2:#9aa4b1;--border:#2c333d;}
body.theme-dark .f input,body.theme-dark .f select,body.theme-dark .f textarea{background:#262d36;color:var(--text);border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .stbl th{background:#1c222a;color:var(--text2);}
body.theme-dark .stbl tr:hover td{background:#222a33;}
body.theme-dark .stbl td{border-color:#2a313a;}
body.theme-dark .modal{background:#1e242c;color:var(--text);}
body.theme-dark .topbar{background:var(--card);border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .pb-card:hover,body.theme-dark .prod-card:hover{background:#222a33;}
body.theme-dark .import-zone{border-color:var(--border);color:var(--text2);}
body.theme-dark .dev-card{background:#1a2027;border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .acl{background:#1e242c;border-color:var(--border);}
body.theme-dark .acl div:hover{background:#262d36;}
body.theme-dark .stg-tabs{border-color:var(--border);}

/* اندازه متن */
body.text-sm{font-size:11px;}
body.text-sm .f input,body.text-sm .f select,body.text-sm .f textarea,body.text-sm .btn{font-size:11px;}
body.text-lg{font-size:15px;}
body.text-lg .f input,body.text-lg .f select,body.text-lg .f textarea,body.text-lg .btn{font-size:14px;}
body.text-lg .topbar-title{font-size:17px;}

/* تراکم چیدمان — دلباز */
body.density-spacious .card{padding:24px 26px;margin-bottom:20px;}
body.density-spacious .page{padding:28px;}
body.density-spacious .f input,body.density-spacious .f select,body.density-spacious .f textarea{padding:9px 12px;}
body.density-spacious .btn{padding:9px 16px;}
body.density-spacious .g2,body.density-spacious .g3,body.density-spacious .g4,body.density-spacious .g5{gap:16px;}
body.density-spacious .stbl td,body.density-spacious .stbl th{padding:11px 14px;}
body.density-spacious .f{gap:6px;}

/* تراکم چیدمان — فشرده */
body.density-compact .card{padding:10px 12px;margin-bottom:8px;}
body.density-compact .page{padding:12px;}
body.density-compact .f input,body.density-compact .f select,body.density-compact .f textarea{padding:4px 7px;}
body.density-compact .btn{padding:5px 10px;}
body.density-compact .g2,body.density-compact .g3,body.density-compact .g4,body.density-compact .g5{gap:6px;}
body.density-compact .stbl td,body.density-compact .stbl th{padding:4px 7px;}

/* گردی گوشه‌ها */
body.radius-sharp .card,body.radius-sharp .btn,body.radius-sharp .f input,body.radius-sharp .f select,body.radius-sharp .f textarea,body.radius-sharp .modal,body.radius-sharp .dev-card{border-radius:3px!important;}
body.radius-round .card{border-radius:18px!important;}
body.radius-round .btn{border-radius:14px!important;}
body.radius-round .f input,body.radius-round .f select,body.radius-round .f textarea{border-radius:12px!important;}
body.radius-round .modal{border-radius:20px!important;}
body.radius-round .dev-card{border-radius:14px!important;}

/* تصویر پس‌زمینه برنامه */
body.has-bg-image::before{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;
  background-image:var(--bg-img);background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-attachment:fixed;
}
body.has-bg-image::after{
  content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,var(--bg-overlay,0.55));
}
body.has-bg-image.theme-dark::after{background:rgba(10,12,15,var(--bg-overlay,0.55));}
/* Tooltip فارسی */
[data-tip]{position:relative;cursor:help;}
[data-tip]:hover::after{content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 6px);right:50%;transform:translateX(50%);background:#222;color:#fff;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;z-index:1000;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.25);font-weight:400;}
[data-tip]:hover::before{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 2px);right:50%;transform:translateX(50%);border:5px solid transparent;border-top-color:#222;z-index:1000;}
/* راهنمای درختی */
.help-tree{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;}
.help-tree-node{border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.help-tree-node:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.help-tree-label{cursor:pointer;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--blue2);background:var(--blue-l);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;user-select:none;font-size:13px;}
.help-tree-label:hover{background:#dceaf8;}
.help-tree-node.collapsed .help-tree-children{display:none;}
.help-tree-node.collapsed .help-tree-chev{transform:rotate(-90deg);}
.help-tree-chev{transition:.15s;font-size:10px;}
.help-tree-children{padding:8px 10px 10px;background:var(--card);}
.help-tree-children .help-card{margin-bottom:8px;}
/* امضای چاپ */
.print-sig-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;margin-top:16px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #ccc;text-align:center;font-size:10px;}
.print-sig-box{min-height:52px;border-top:1px dashed #888;padding-top:6px;margin-top:28px;}
/* صفحه تقویم */
.cal-page-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:4px;text-align:center;margin-top:10px;}
.cal-page-grid .dow{font-size:10px;color:#999;padding:4px;}
.cal-page-grid .day{padding:8px 0;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;}
.cal-page-grid .day:hover{background:var(--blue-l);}
.cal-page-grid .day.today{border:2px solid var(--blue);font-weight:700;}
.cal-page-grid .day.sel{background:var(--blue2);color:#fff;}
.cal-page-grid .day.empty{visibility:hidden;}
.cal-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.war-section-disabled{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none;filter:grayscale(.3);}
.wsoc-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;background:#fafafa;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ===== LOGIN OVERLAY ===== -->
<div id="login-overlay" style="position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#2563eb);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;direction:rtl;font-family:Tahoma,sans-serif">
  <div style="background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:36px 32px;width:90%;max-width:380px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.3);text-align:center">
    <div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:8px">🔒</div>
    <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#1e3a5f;margin-bottom:4px">Laegh Electronic Parsian</div>
    <div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-bottom:24px">برای ورود، رمز عبور را وارد کنید</div>
    <input type="password" id="login-pw-input" placeholder="رمز عبور" style="width:100%;padding:11px 14px;border:1.5px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:12px;outline:none" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')attemptLogin()">
    <button onclick="attemptLogin()" style="width:100%;padding:11px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:Tahoma">ورود</button>
    <div id="login-error-msg" style="color:#e74c3c;font-size:12px;margin-top:10px;min-height:16px"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== INVOICE PAGE ===== -->

  <div class="card-title">🏪 اطلاعات فاکتور</div>

    <div class="f"><label>شماره فاکتور</label><div class="badge badge-inv" id="inv-num">LEP-0001</div></div>
    <div class="f"><label>تاریخ</label><input id="inv-date" readonly placeholder="۱۴۰۳/۰۸/۱۵" onclick="openDatePicker(this)"></div>
